      "quotes": [

      ]
    },
    {
      "unit_id": "U0006",
      "claim_ids": ["C0006"],
      "status": "covered",

      "quotes": [
        "Woody materials may be chipped and distributed through the backfill when approved by the regulatory authority."
      ]
    }
  ]
